description: National Georegister of the Netherlands is an open data portal listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by PDOK. Geo Data Portal Netherlands. Coverage: Netherlands. The European data portal lists 9,329 datasets from this catalogue. A multilingual title search (26 languages, transport, energy, water, digital and hazard words) found 1,174 datasets about infrastructure or natural hazards, catalogued as 232 records (collections of three or more datasets from one publisher or service host, and single datasets); the rest are outside the scope of this catalogue. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure and hazard data of this country. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
